justification: Inspected `core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/core/JITWatchConfig.java` (970 LOC), `JITWatchConstants.java` (359), `TagProcessor.java` (304), `ErrorLog.java` (60), and `IJITListener.java` (15).
